title: What If You Fell Into a Black Hole?

hook.text:
WHAT IF YOU FELL
IN A BLACK HOLE?

segments.text: Fall into a black hole, and you become spaghetti.
Say it's 10 times heavier than our Sun.
As you fall, your friend sees your clock slow down.
You turn red, and seem to freeze at the edge, forever.
But you feel your feet pulled harder than your head.
Your body stretches long and thin, like a noodle.
At the edge, that stretch hits 20,000,000 times Earth's gravity.
The twist? A giant black hole lets you fall in feeling nothing.
Until deep inside... you still become spaghetti.
